This document details the process of cleaning, preparing, and analyzing humoral data related to HBV vaccination. The analysis involves several steps, including data import, merging of different batches, handling of duplicates, and integration of metadata. The primary goal is to explore the antibody responses over time, particularly in different age groups and vaccine types.

# --- Load Data ---
```{r revised-load-merge-data}
b0 <- read_xlsx("./data/elisa_output.xlsx")
part_merge <- read_xlsx("./data/traditional_elisa_merged_batch_cmrs_rs.batch1.xlsx")
b2 <- read_csv("./data/20240802_hbv_elisa_batch2_riddhimaa.csv")
b3 <- read_csv("./data/20241112_hbv_elisa_batch3_riddhimaa.csv")
b4 <- read_csv("./data/20250402_hbv_elisa_batch4_riddhimaa.csv")
b5 <- read_csv("./data/20250620_hbv_elisa_batch5_riddhimaa.csv")

b6 <- read_xlsx("./data/20251212_hbv_elisa_hmc.xlsx")
b7 <- read_xlsx("./data/20260122_elisa_hmc.xlsx")

b2$ABS <- b2$notes <- NULL;  b3$ABS <- b3$notes <- NULL;   b4$ABS <- b4$notes <- NULL
names(b2) <- names(b3) <- names(b4) <- c("SAMPLE", "elisa.HBsAb")
joined.elisa <- merge(b3, b4, all = TRUE)
joined.elisa <- as.data.table(joined.elisa)
joined.elisa <- joined.elisa[!SAMPLE %like% '84']
joined.elisa[, c('Participant','Visit') := tstrsplit(SAMPLE, "-", fill = NA)]

b2 <- as.data.table(b2)
b2[, c('Visit','Participant') := tstrsplit(SAMPLE, "-", fill = NA)]
joined.elisa <- rbind(joined.elisa, b2)
joined.elisa[, Participant:= paste0("hbvx-00", Participant)]
joined.elisa$SAMPLE <- NULL

b5 <- as.data.table(b5)
b5$C <- b5$E <- b5$F <- NULL
names(b5) <- c('Participant', 'Visit', 'elisa.HBsAb')
b5 <- b5[!is.na(Participant)]
b5 <- b5[, Participant := tolower(substr(Participant, 5, 13))]

setDT(b6) 
b6[, c('Participant', 'Visit') := tstrsplit(subject_timepoint, "_", fill = NA)]
b6[, Participant:= paste0("hbvx-", Participant)]
b6$subject_timepoint <- NULL

setDT(b7)
b7[, c('Participant', 'Visit') := tstrsplit(subject_timepoint, "_", fill = NA)]
b7[, Participant:= paste0("hbvx-", Participant)]
b7$subject_timepoint <- NULL

joined.elisa <- rbind(joined.elisa, b5,b6,b7)
rm(b2, b3, b4, b5, b6)

b0$Visit <- paste0("v", substr(b0$`Event Name`, 7, 7), "w", substr(b0$`Event Name`, 16, 16))
b0$`Event Name` <- b0$`ELISA Value Issue` <-  NULL
names(b0) <-c('Participant', 'elisa.HBsAb', 'Visit')
# b0$Part.Visit <- c(paste0(b0$Participant, "_", b0$Visit))

joined.elisa <- rbind(joined.elisa, b0)


# clean up data table 
part_merge$make.unique <- paste0(part_merge$subject,'_',part_merge$timepoint)  # column for finding duplicates
part_merge <- as.data.table(part_merge)
part_merge <- part_merge[!note %like% '1000x_dilution']

part_merge$note <- part_merge$experiment <- part_merge$collected_by <- NULL  # remove 
names(part_merge) <- c('Participant', 'Visit', 'elisa.HBsAb','make.unique')
part_merge[, `:=` (mIU.ave = mean(elisa.HBsAb, na.rm=T), mIU.n = .N), by=make.unique]
part_merge[, discrepancy := abs(elisa.HBsAb - mIU.ave)]
discrep.values <- part_merge[mIU.n>1, .(Participant, Visit, elisa.HBsAb, mIU.ave, discrepancy)]
discrep.values[order(-discrepancy)][1:10] 
# all of the values that are discordant look aberrantly low, so will favor taking simple max of any replicates values
part_merge <- part_merge[, .SD[which.max(elisa.HBsAb)], by = .(Participant, Visit)]
rm(discrep.values)
part_merge$mIU.ave <- part_merge$mIU.n <- part_merge$discrepancy <- part_merge$make.unique <- NULL
part_merge <- part_merge[!Participant == '0']
part_merge[, Participant := paste0("hbvx-", Participant)]
joined.elisa <- rbind(joined.elisa, part_merge)

joined.elisa[, Visit := tolower(Visit)]
joined.elisa[, Participant := tolower(Participant)]
joined.elisa[, make.unique := paste0(Participant, "_", Visit)]  # search for duplicates 
joined.elisa[duplicated(make.unique), make.unique]  # 122 duplicate entries found 

reconciled.joined.elisa <- joined.elisa[, .(
  # 1. Apply logic for mIU
  elisa.HBsAb = if (.N == 1) {
    elisa.HBsAb # If not a duplicate, keep value
  } else if (any(elisa.HBsAb < 10)) {
    max(elisa.HBsAb) # If one is < 10, keep the larger value  (low value could represent assay failure)
  } else {
    mean(elisa.HBsAb) # If both (all) are > 10, find the average
  },

  # 2. Keep the first entry for other descriptive columns
  Participant = Participant[1], Visit  = Visit [1] ),
  by = make.unique]
rm(part_merge, b0, joined.elisa)

# > reconciled.joined.elisa
#         make.unique elisa.HBsAb Participant  Visit
#              <char>       <num>      <char> <char>
#   1: hbvx-0003_v3w0  290.266822   hbvx-0003   v3w0
#   2: hbvx-0003_v3w1  345.778788   hbvx-0003   v3w1
#   3: hbvx-0014_v1w0    5.562096   hbvx-0014   v1w0
#   4: hbvx-0015_v3w3  288.583638   hbvx-0015   v3w3

```

# --- Load and Manage Metadata ---
```{r manage-metadata, results='hide'}
redcap.baseline.demog <- fread("./data/HepatitisBVaccineStu-Demographics.csv")
addtl.metadata <- fread("./data/HBV metadata - DatesOffset.csv")
glimpse(redcap.baseline.demog)
names(redcap.baseline.demog) <- c("Participant", 'Event', 'FirstVisit', 'Age', 'Sex', 'Race', 'Ethnicity','Comments','Demog.complete','BMI','Randomization')
redcap.baseline.demog[, Race := as.character(Race)]
redcap.baseline.demog <- redcap.baseline.demog[, c('Demog.complete', 'Event', 'Comments','Randomization') := NULL]
redcap.baseline.demog[, Participant := tolower(Participant) ]
redcap.baseline.demog <- redcap.baseline.demog[!Participant %like% 'test']
redcap.baseline.demog[, Sex := fifelse(Sex == 1, 'F', 'M')]
redcap.baseline.demog[, Ethnicity := fifelse(Ethnicity == 1, 'Hispanic', 'Not Hispanic')]
redcap.baseline.demog[Race == '2', Race := 'Asian']
redcap.baseline.demog[Race == '3', Race := 'Black/AfricanAmerican']
redcap.baseline.demog[Race == '5', Race := 'White/Caucasian']
redcap.baseline.demog[Race == '6' | Race == '7', Race := 'Multiple/NR']
redcap.baseline.demog[, FirstVisit := as.Date(FirstVisit, format="%m/%d/%Y")]

addtl.metadata[, Participant := tolower(substr(Participant, 5, 14))]
addtl.metadata[, DateEnrolled := as.Date(DateEnrolled, format="%m/%d/%Y")]
addtl.metadata[, HBsAb1date := as.Date(HBsAb1date, format="%m/%d/%Y")]
addtl.metadata[, HBcAbdate  := as.Date(HBcAbdate, format="%m/%d/%Y")]
addtl.metadata[, DateLastVaxBeforeBiopsy  := as.Date(DateLastVaxBeforeBiopsy, format="%m/%d/%Y")]
addtl.metadata[, Ultrasound  := as.Date(Ultrasound, format="%m/%d/%Y")]
addtl.metadata[, StatusAtEnrollment := fifelse(StatusAtEnrollment == 'No Hep B Vx', 'HBVnaive' ,'HBVimmune')]
addtl.metadata[, Study.arm := 'HBVnaive-Alum']
addtl.metadata[StatusAtEnrollment == 'HBVnaive' & Product == 'Heplisav' , Study.arm := 'HBVnaive-CpG']
addtl.metadata[StatusAtEnrollment == 'HBVimmune', Study.arm := 'HBVimmune-Alum']
addtl.metadata[, MedsAtEnrollment := strsplit(CurrentMeds, split = ';')] 
addtl.metadata[, PastHistory := strsplit(PastHistory, split = ';')]
addtl.metadata[, ImmunizationHx := strsplit(ImmunizationHx, split = ' ___')]

metadata <- merge(redcap.baseline.demog, addtl.metadata, by = 'Participant', all = TRUE)
metadata[, DaysFromVaxToUltrasound := as.numeric(Ultrasound - DateLastVaxBeforeBiopsy)]
rm(addtl.metadata, redcap.baseline.demog
   #, dupl
   )

# > metadata
# Key: <Participant>
#      Participant FirstVisit   Age    Sex                  Race    Ethnicity   BMI StatusAtEnrollment KnownNR  Product DateEnrolled YearsSinceLastVax
#           <char>     <Date> <int> <char>                <char>       <char> <num>             <char>  <char>   <char>       <Date>             <num>
#   1:   hbvx-0001 2022-07-07    47      M       White/Caucasian Not Hispanic  29.1          HBVimmune       Y EngerixB   2022-07-06                25
#   2:   hbvx-0002 2022-09-06    41      M       White/Caucasian Not Hispanic  29.6           HBVnaive       N EngerixB   2022-09-01                NA
```

# --- Save Merged Metadata ---
```{r write-metadata}
#set negative elisa values to 0.01
colnames(reconciled.joined.elisa)
reconciled.joined.elisa[elisa.HBsAb < 0, elisa.HBsAb := 0.1]
#change v3w3 --> v3w4
reconciled.joined.elisa[Visit == 'v3w3', Visit := 'v3w4']
table(reconciled.joined.elisa$Visit)
saveRDS(reconciled.joined.elisa, "./outs/reconciled_joined_elisa.RDS")
fwrite(metadata[,.SD, .SDcols = !c('MedsAtEnrollment', 'ImmunizationHx', 'PastHistory')], "./outs/merged_metadata.csv")
```

# --- Merge ELISA Data with Metadata ---
```{r merge-metadata-and-elisa}
elisa_mergeMeta <- merge(reconciled.joined.elisa, metadata, by = 'Participant', all.x = TRUE)
elisa_mergeMeta[, AgeSplit50 := fifelse(Age>50,'>50', '<=50')]
```

# --- Break down of antibody by age ---
```{r make-interesting-plots}
elisa_mergeMeta <- readRDS("./outs/elisa_mergeMeta.RDS") #this is final merged dataset with meta
medianData <- elisa_mergeMeta[, .(median.elisa = median(elisa.HBsAb, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(Visit, Study.arm, AgeSplit50)]

ggplot(elisa_mergeMeta[Study.arm == 'HBVnaive-Alum'], aes(y = elisa.HBsAb, x = Visit, color=AgeSplit50)) + 
  geom_line(aes(group=Participant), alpha=0.2) + geom_point(size=2,alpha=0.6)  + 
  geom_line(data=medianData[Study.arm == 'HBVnaive-Alum'], aes(y = median.elisa, x = Visit, color=AgeSplit50, group=AgeSplit50), alpha=1, linewidth=3)+ 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#E66100","#5D3A9B"))+ scale_y_log10() +  
  ct2 

elisa_mergeMeta[Study.arm == 'HBVnaive-Alum'] %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Visit, y = elisa.HBsAb, color=AgeSplit50)) + 
  geom_boxplot(position=position_dodge(width=0.8), alpha=0.5) + 
  geom_line(aes(group=Participant, color=AgeSplit50), alpha=0.2, position=position_dodge(width=0.8)) +
  geom_beeswarm(aes(color=AgeSplit50), size=2, dodge.width = 0.8, alpha=0.8) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#E66100","#5D3A9B"))+ scale_y_log10() +  
  ct2
```

```{r filtering}
metadata[,Age]

alum  <- metadata[StatusAtEnrollment == "HBVnaive" & Product == "EngerixB"]
cpg   <- metadata[StatusAtEnrollment == "HBVnaive" & Product == "Heplisav"]
boost <- metadata[StatusAtEnrollment == "HBVimmune"]

alum_timepoints <- c("v1w0", "v1w1", "v2w0", "v2w1", "v2w4", "v3w0", "v3w1", "v3w4")
cpg_timepoints <- c("v1w0", "v1w1", "v2w0", "v2w1", "v2w4")
boost_timepoints <- c("v1w0", "v1w1", "v1w4")

alum[,alum_timepoints] <- NA
glimpse(alum)
cpg[,cpg_timepoints] <- NA
boost[,boost_timepoints] <- NA


alum
alum_long <- melt(alum, measure.vars = alum_timepoints, variable.name = "Visit")[, `:=`(Participant_Visit = paste(Participant, Visit, sep = "_"), Study.arm ='HBVnaive-Alum')]
cpg_long <- melt(cpg, measure.vars = cpg_timepoints, variable.name = "Visit")[, `:=`(Participant_Visit = paste(Participant, Visit, sep = "_"), Study.arm = "HBVnaive-CpG")]
boost_long <- melt(boost, measure.vars = boost_timepoints, variable.name = "Visit")[, `:=`(Participant_Visit = paste(Participant, Visit, sep = "_"), Study.arm = 'HBVimmune-Alum')]
```

#--- Merge visit dates with offset ---
```{r visit date offset merge}

#delete below. this portion contains visit date offset information
elisa_mergeMeta <- readRDS("./outs/elisa_mergeMeta.RDS") #this is final merged dataset with meta
visit_dates <- read_xlsx("./data/hbv_visit_dates_organize.xlsx", sheet = "master_log_cleaned")
meta_offset<- read_xlsx("./data/HBV_visit_offset.xlsx", shee = "OriginalData")
setDT(visit_dates)
setDT(meta_offset) 
glimpse(visit_dates)

colnames(visit_dates)
date_cols <- c("v1w0", "v1w1", "v1w4", "v2w0", "v2w1", "v2w4", "v3w0", "v3w1",  "v3w4",  "optional.v1", "optional.v2")
visit_dates[, (date_cols) := lapply(.SD, as.Date, format="%m/%d/%Y"), .SDcols = date_cols]

glimpse(visit_dates)
setnames(visit_dates, old = c("Participant ID"), new = c("Participant"))
glimpse(meta_offset)
meta_offset <- meta_offset[, .(Participant, Date.Offset)]
visit_dates[meta_offset, on = .(Participant), Date.Offset := i.Date.Offset]
# Melt visit_dates to long format
#visit_dates_long <- melt(visit_dates, id.vars = "Participant", measure.vars = date_cols, variable.name = "Visit", value.name = "VisitDate")

new_cols <- paste0(date_cols,"_offset")
visit_dates[!is.na(Date.Offset), (new_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) x + Date.Offset), .SDcols = date_cols]
visit_dates[,FirstVisitDate := v1w0_offset]

visit_offset_only <- visit_dates[, .SD, .SDcols = patterns("offset|Participant|First")]
glimpse(visit_offset_only)
#make visit_offset_only longer 
visit_offset_only <- melt(visit_offset_only, id.vars = c("Participant", "FirstVisitDate"), measure.vars = patterns("_offset$"), variable.name = "Visit", value.name = "offset_VisitDate")
glimpse(visit_offset_only)

visit_offset_only[,Participant := tolower(Participant)]
visit_offset_only[,Participant := str_replace(Participant, "nlv-", "")]
visit_offset_only[,make.unique := paste0(tolower(Participant), "_", Visit)]

#delete above
visit_offset_only <- na.omit(visit_offset_only)
visit_offset_only[,make.unique := str_replace(make.unique, "_offset", "")]
visit_offset_only[,Visit := str_replace(Visit, "_offset", "")]
write_csv(visit_offset_only, "./outs/visit_dates_with_offset.csv")

#clean environment
to_keep <- c("visit_offset_only", "elisa_mergeMeta", "ct2")
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), to_keep))
glimpse(visit_offset_only)

elisa_mergeMeta <- merge(visit_offset_only, elisa_mergeMeta, by = c("make.unique","Participant", "Visit"), all = TRUE)
glimpse(elisa_mergeMeta)
names(elisa_mergeMeta)
not_meta <- c("make.unique", "Participant", "offset_VisitDate", "elisa.HBsAb", "Visit")
meta_to_impute <- setdiff(names(elisa_mergeMeta), not_meta)

elisa_mergeMeta[, (meta_to_impute) := lapply(.SD, function(x) x[!is.na(x)][1]), 
     by = Participant, 
     .SDcols = meta_to_impute]
elisa_mergeMeta[,FirstVisit := NULL]
elisa_mergeMeta[,DaysFromFirstVisit := as.numeric(offset_VisitDate - FirstVisitDate)]
glimpse(elisa_mergeMeta)
saveRDS(elisa_mergeMeta, "./outs/elisa_mergeMeta_with_offsetVisitDates.rds") #full elisa with offset visit dates
```

```{r}
geo_summary <- function(x) {
  x <- x[x > 0 & !is.na(x)]  # Remove zeros and NAs
  if (length(x) < 2) return(data.frame(y = NA, ymin = NA, ymax = NA))
  
  logx <- log(x)
  m    <- mean(logx)
  se   <- sd(logx) / sqrt(length(logx))
  ci   <- 1.96 * se  # 95% CI multiplier
  
  data.frame(
    y    = exp(m),
    ymin = exp(m - ci),
    ymax = exp(m + ci)
  )
}
```

```{r exploratory-analysis, eval=FALSE}
# Check for missing age data for a specific subject.

  stat_summary(fun=mean, geom="point", shape = 21, group = 1, aes(fill = age_group), color = "black", size = 2)+ scale_fill_manual( #labels = c(expression(""<"50"), expression("">="50")), values = c("#28b57c","#ce2fbf")) +

# Calculate arithmetic mean and confidence intervals.

df.alum.mean <- df.alum %>%
  #arith mean filter(group == "Alum") %>%
  filter(!timepoint == "v3w3") %>%
  group_by(timepoint, age_group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean=mean(elisa), median = median(elisa), sd = sd(elisa)) %>%
  mutate(sem = sd / sqrt(n - 1), CI_lower = mean +
  qt((1-0.95)/2, n - 1) * sem, CI_upper = mean - qt((1-0.95)/2, n - 1) * sem)

# Plot the arithmetic mean with confidence intervals.

ggplot(df_mean, aes(x=timepoint, y=mean, color = age_group, group = age_group)) +
  geom_line(aes(x=timepoint, y=mean, color=age_group)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=CI_lower,ymax=CI_upper,fill=age_group),color="grey70",alpha=0.4) +ct2 +
  ylab("elisa")+ scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number())

# --- Geometric Mean and Quartiles ---

# Functions are defined to calculate geometric mean and quartiles for visualization.

geo_mean <- function(x) { x <- x[x > 0] if (length(x) == 0) { return(NA_real_) } exp(mean(log(x))) }

# Define a function to calculate geometric mean and quartiles.

geo_summary <- function(x) { x <- x[x > 0] if (length(x) == 0) return(data.frame(y = NA, ymin = NA, ymax = NA)) logx <- log(x) data.frame( y = exp(mean(logx)), # geometric mean ymin = exp(quantile(logx, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)), # Q1 ymax = exp(quantile(logx, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)) # Q3 ) }

# Define a function to calculate geometric mean and 95% confidence intervals.

geo_mean_CI <- function(x) { x <- x[x > 0] # drop non-positive values if (length(x) == 0) return(data.frame(y = NA, ymin = NA, ymax = NA)) logx <- log(x) n <- length(logx) mean_log <- mean(logx) se_log <- sd(logx) / sqrt(n) # 95% CI on log scale CI_lower <- mean_log - 1.96 * se_log CI_upper <- mean_log +
  1.96 * se_log data.frame( y = exp(mean_log), # geometric mean ymin = exp(CI_lower), # lower CI ymax = exp(CI_upper) # upper CI ) }

unique(df$timepoint)

# --- Linear Mixed-Effects Model ---

# A linear mixed-effects model (LME) is used to analyze the interaction between timepoint and age group.

# The following commented out code shows a basic LME model.

# df.alum %>%

# #mutate(log_elisa = log(elisa)) %>%

# lmer(log(elisa) ~ timepoint * age_group + (1 | subject), data = .) %>%

# anova()

# Basic LME model

fit <- lmer(log(elisa) ~ timepoint * age_group +
  (1|subject), data = df.alum)
  aov_tab <- anova(fit) pval <- signif(aov_tab["timepoint:age_group", "Pr(>F)"], 3)
  pval
  summary(fit) # The following commented out code shows how to get p-values using Kenward-Roger's approximation. #anova(fit, ddf = "Kenward-Roger")

# LME model adjusting for baseline

temp <- df.alum %>%
  filter(!subject == "0082") %>%
  #no v1w0 group_by(subject) %>%
  mutate( baseline_log_elisa = log(elisa[timepoint == "v1w0"]) ) %>%
  ungroup()

temp$sex <- factor(temp$sex)

fit <- lmer( log(elisa) ~ baseline_log_elisa +
  #sex +
  bmi +
  age +
  timepoint * age_group +
  (1 | subject), data = temp ) aov_tab <- anova(fit) pval <- signif(aov_tab["timepoint:age_group", "Pr(>F)"], 3)

# Plot the LME results.

df.alum %>%
  mutate( timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("v1w0", "v1w1", "v1w4", "v2w0", "v2w1", "v2w4", "v3w0", "v3w1", "v3w4", "v3w3")) ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = timepoint, y = elisa)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = subject, color = age_group), size = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#FFD699", "#D8C4F5"), guide = "none") +
  new_scale_color() +
  geom_smooth( method = "lm", se = TRUE, aes(color = age_group, group = age_group), formula = y ~ as.numeric(x) ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#E66100", "#5D3A9B")) +
  labs(x = "Timepoint", y = "elisa") +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number()) +
  ct2 +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +
  annotate("text", x = 5, y = 800, label = paste0("Interaction p = ", pval), hjust = 0) +
  xlab("") ggsave ("./outs/lme_ageGroup_time_interaction.pdf", height = 4, width = 6)

# Paired Wilcoxon test to compare timepoints in the booster group.

  filter(timepoint %in% c("v1w0", "v1w1","v1w4")) %>%

  add_xy_position(x = "timepoint")

#geo mean with 95% CI geo_mean_CI <- function(x) { x <- x[x > 0] # drop non-positive values if (length(x) == 0) return(data.frame(y = NA, ymin = NA, ymax = NA)) logx <- log(x) n <- length(logx) mean_log <- mean(logx) se_log <- sd(logx) / sqrt(n) # 95% CI on log scale CI_lower <- mean_log - 1.96 * se_log CI_upper <- mean_log + 1.96 * se_log data.frame( y = exp(mean_log), # geometric mean ymin = exp(CI_lower), # lower CI ymax = exp(CI_upper) # upper CI ) }
```
